task.title: Write the upstream specs
task.body:
Specs for the two changes this app wants in Genbeya, written so that neither blocks the first version: [[Upstream]].

- [x] [[Kit build]]: the bundle, its host interface and protocol, CI and releases
- [x] [[Attached images]]: folders, names, references and processing for pages, tasks and pull requests, and the change ID rule
- [x] What the app does until Genbeya has each
